about: Freeze 41, block L, the rung at 2,000 messages a second: run with RATE=2000 DURATION=70 WARMUP_S=20. Queue: python3 scripts/run_queue.py make --design docs/results/order_scope/l2000_design.json --out runs/azure/queues/l2000.csv. The pilot found the clients could not hold 5,000 a second within the integrity rule (Redis sent 3,536 and 3,579 a second), so the top rung is 2,000, as DESIGN.md provides; and that at 2,000 an 88% load cannot be held beside the clients (80.0-81.9% held), so this rung runs its idle setups only (D44-10).
